```{r}
dfrna = read.csv('../data/RNA_meta_final.csv')
#dfrna <- dfrna[!is.na(dfrna$MS), ] # not considering ones without a MS group

###
rna_cn = read.csv('../data/RNA_CN_zscores.csv')
dfrna$CN = rna_cn$CN
fov_info = read.csv('../../../fig2_related/analy/data/FOV_ann.csv')
colnames(fov_info) = c('tma_fov', 'BH_ann')
dfrna = merge(x = dfrna, y = fov_info, by = "tma_fov", all.x = TRUE)
dfrna = subset(dfrna, dfrna$BH_ann == 'Tumor')
###

dfrna$group = 'p53_WT'
dfrna$group[dfrna$MS == 'p53'] = 'p53_abn'
```


```{r}
### this part was not actually used that much
# install.packages(c("dplyr","ggplot2","ggpubr","rstatix"))
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)

dfrna <- dfrna %>%
  mutate(across(c(cluster_composition, tma_fov, group), as.character))

df_pct <- dfrna %>%
  count(tma_fov, cluster_composition) %>%
  group_by(tma_fov) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(dfrna %>% distinct(tma_fov, group), by = "tma_fov")

valid_clusters <- df_pct %>%
  distinct(tma_fov, cluster_composition, group) %>%
  count(cluster_composition, group) %>%
  group_by(cluster_composition) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(group) == 2, min(n) >= 2) %>%
  pull(cluster_composition)

stat_test <- df_pct %>%
  filter(cluster_composition %in% valid_clusters) %>%
  group_by(cluster_composition) %>%
  wilcox_test(percent ~ group) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "cluster_composition", dodge = 0.75)

```



######### cluster version (both FOV and CNs)??

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(scales)

# 3) Cluster the CN axis (rows)
cn_wide <- df_pct %>%
  select(cluster_composition, tma_fov, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = tma_fov,
              values_from = percent,
              values_fill  = list(percent = 0))
cn_mat <- as.matrix(cn_wide[,-1])
rownames(cn_mat) <- cn_wide$cluster_composition
cn_ord <- rownames(cn_mat)[hclust(dist(cn_mat))$order]

# 4) (Optional) Cluster the FOV axis globally (columns)
fov_wide <- df_pct %>%
  select(tma_fov, cluster_composition, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = cluster_composition,
              values_from = percent,
              values_fill  = list(percent = 0))
fov_mat <- as.matrix(fov_wide[,-1])
rownames(fov_mat) <- fov_wide$tma_fov
fov_ord <- rownames(fov_mat)[hclust(dist(fov_mat))$order]

# 5) Apply those new factor levels
df_plot <- df_pct %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_composition = factor(cluster_composition, levels = cn_ord),
    tma_fov            = factor(tma_fov,            levels = fov_ord)
  )

## non colored version
ggplot(df_plot,
       aes(x = tma_fov, y = cluster_composition,
           size = percent, fill = cluster_composition)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "grey30", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12,
                  guide = guide_legend(title = "% per FOV")) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, name = "CN") +
  labs(
    x     = "FOV",
    y     = "Copy-Number cluster",
    title = "Per-FOV CN composition (clustered axes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid  = element_blank()
  )

```


### more refined and colored version

```{r}
cccd <- c(
  "#e31a1c", "#6a3d9a", "#009900", "#00cccc", "#ccff00",
  "#ff6699", "#7f007f", "#ff7f00", "#660000", "#006d2c",
  "#1f78b4", "#b2df8a", "#a6cee3", "#ffff99", "#cab2d6"
)
names(cccd) <- as.character(0:14)

ggplot(df_plot,
       aes(x = tma_fov, y = cluster_composition,
           size = percent, fill = cluster_composition)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "grey30", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12,
                  guide = guide_legend(title = "% per FOV")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cccd, name = "CN") +
  labs(x = "FOV", y = "Copy-Number cluster",
       title = "Per-FOV CN composition") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major   = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x    = unit(1, "cm"),
    aspect.ratio     = 0.5
  )

ggsave('../plots/bubble_freqCN_RNA.svg', width = 15, height = 8)

```



```{r}
fov_wide <- df_pct %>%
  select(tma_fov, cluster_composition, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cluster_composition,
    values_from = percent,
    values_fill = list(percent = 0)
  )
fov_mat <- as.matrix(fov_wide[ , -1])
rownames(fov_mat) <- fov_wide$tma_fov

fov_ord <- rownames(fov_mat)[ hclust(dist(fov_mat))$order ]

df_plot <- df_pct %>%
  mutate(
    # apply new FOV order
    tma_fov = factor(tma_fov, levels = fov_ord),
    # keep CNs in numeric order (0,1,2,…)
    cluster_composition = factor(cluster_composition,
                                 levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(cluster_composition)))))
  )

ggplot(df_plot,
       aes(x = tma_fov, y = cluster_composition,
           size = percent, fill = cluster_composition)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "grey30", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12, guide = guide_legend(title = "% per FOV")) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, name = "CN") +
  labs(x = "FOV",
       y = "Copy-Number cluster",
       title = "Per-FOV CN composition (FOVs clustered only)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid  = element_blank()
  )
```
